claim: As of mid-2026 the top open-weight models by overall score are DeepSeek V4 Pro (87), Kimi K2.6 (84), GLM-5.1 (83), and Qwen3.5 397B Reasoning (79).
quote: DeepSeek V4 Pro (Max) - 87 overall | 1M context ... Kimi K2.6 - 84 ... GLM-5.1 - 83 ... Qwen3.5 397B (Reasoning) - 79

claim: DeepSeek V4 launched April 24, 2026 under MIT license; V4-Pro is a 1.6T-parameter MoE (49B active) and V4-Flash a 284B MoE (13B active), both with 1M-token context, with V4-Pro scoring 80.6% on SWE-bench Verified.
quote: DeepSeek V4 Pro Complete Guide: 1.6T Parameters, 80.6% SWE-bench, Open Source (2026)

claim: Kimi K2.6 (Moonshot AI, April 2026) is a 1T-parameter MoE with 32B active per token, 256K context, modified MIT license, scoring 80.2% SWE-bench Verified and 58.6% SWE-bench Pro.
quote: 1-trillion-parameter sparse Mixture-of-Experts with 32 billion active parameters per token ... 80.2% on SWE-Bench Verified and 58.6% on SWE-Bench Pro

claim: Zhipu's GLM-5 is a 744B-parameter open-weight MoE (40-44B active) under MIT license, trained on Huawei Ascend chips; GLM-5.1 scores ~94.6% of Claude Opus 4.6 coding performance.
quote: GLM-5 | Zhipu AI's Next-Generation Large Language Model (745B Parameters)

claim: OpenAI's gpt-oss-120b (5.1B active, MoE, fits 80GB VRAM in MXFP4) and gpt-oss-20b are Apache 2.0 open-weight reasoning models with 128K context, released August 2025.
quote: gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b ... The 120B model has 5.1B active parameters per token and uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture ... Apache 2.0 license

claim: Qwen3-Coder ships in 480B-A35B and 30B-A3B sizes (plus FP8/GGUF quants), with results comparable to Claude Sonnet on agentic coding; repo has 16.6k stars.
quote: Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct ... Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct ... 16.6k stars ... results comparable to Claude Sonnet

claim: Qwen3.6-27B is a dense 27B model under Apache 2.0 that outperforms the much larger Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on every major coding benchmark, bringing flagship-level coding to a consumer-runnable dense model.
quote: Qwen3.6-27B: 27B Model Beats 397B on Coding (2026) ... With only 27B parameters, it outperforms the Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on every major coding benchmark

claim: Gemma 4 26B (3.8B active MoE, Apache 2.0, 256K context) is the best practical local pick running on 24GB VRAM, while Phi-4 (14B, MIT) runs on 16GB and DeepSeek R1 distills (1.5B-70B, MIT) cover smaller tiers.
quote: Top Local Pick: Gemma 4 26B A4B ... only 3.8B active parameters ... Apache 2.0 license ... 256K context window ... Phi-4 | 14B | MIT ... DeepSeek R1 ... distills (1.5B-70B)

claim: Llama 4 Scout (109B total, 17B active, 16 experts, 10M context) fits a single H100 but needs 32GB+ unified memory for local use; Maverick is ~400B with 128 experts; the Llama license is not OSI-open and restricts EU vision use.
quote: Llama 4 Scout is 109B total with 16 experts and a 10M-token context, while Maverick is approximately 400B with 128 experts ... Both have 17 billion active parameters per token

claim: Mistral Small 4 (released March 16, 2026, Apache 2.0) is a 119B MoE activating ~6B params per token and fits a single consumer GPU with quantization; Mistral Large 3 also ships Apache 2.0.
quote: Mistral Small 4 is a 119B-parameter MoE that activates only approximately 6B parameters per token ... Mistral Large 3 and Mistral Small 4 now ship under Apache 2.0
